items.title: Knicks announce they have signed James Wiseman, Ochai Agbaji and Bruce Brown  to an Exhibit 9 contracts
items.author: Tommy Beer
items.body_excerpt:
Knicks announce they have signed James Wiseman, Ochai Agbaji and Bruce Brown  to an Exhibit 9 contracts

Three more vets to come in and compete for the final roster spot.

items.title: Knicks having an amazing Exhibit 9 competition between Bruce Brown, John Konchar, Ochai Agbaji, Drew Eubanks, and James Wiseman
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Knicks having an amazing Exhibit 9 competition between Bruce Brown, John Konchar, Ochai Agbaji, Drew Eubanks, and James Wiseman

And I'd be most interested in Eubanks and Wiseman there, because the Knicks have KAT, Andre Drummond, and the matched offer sheet where Moussa Cisse was gonna be at center

items.title: [Marc Stein] The Knicks have also just signed Ochai Agbaji.
items.author: Jimmy0034
items.body_excerpt: The reigning champions, just like the Knicks did last season, have brought in a slew of veterans to compete for their last two roster vacancies: Ochai Agbaji, Bruce Brown and John Konchar on the wing and big man Drew Eubanks. The Knicks have also just signed James Wiseman.…

items.title: Bruce Brown, James Wiseman, Drew Eubanks, John Konchar, and Ochai Agbaji is a wildly impressive group of Ex9 guys for the Knicks.

items.title: The New York Knicks have signed Ochai Agbaji to an Exhibit 9 deal, team says. Agbaji has averaged 7.2 points in four NBA seasons with the Utah Jazz, Toronto Raptors, and Brooklyn Nets.
items.author: Michael Scotto
items.body_excerpt: The New York Knicks have signed Ochai Agbaji to an Exhibit 9 deal, team says. Agbaji has averaged 7.2 points in four NBA seasons with the Utah Jazz, Toronto Raptors, and Brooklyn Nets.
